failures.text: Places returns 400 with error UNSUPPORTED_CITY when CityId maps to no city.
Dashboard maps an exception from fetch or response JSON parsing to 503 with PLACES_UNAVAILABLE; this handler does not reveal whether Places completed the save before that error.

guarantees.text: The source shows no request idempotency key in these handlers; retry and duplicate-save semantics are unresolved at this boundary.
A successful Places response follows the awaited repository.Save call, but its storage and commit outcome are outside this wrapper contract.

operation.text: Dashboard sends POST /places to the declared Places.Save target.

request.text: Dashboard serializes request.body as JSON and sets content-type to application/json. The body schema is not established by these two handler bodies.
Places reads SavePlace.CityId; an unsupported mapped city returns 400 with UNSUPPORTED_CITY.

response.text: For a supported mapped city, Places awaits repository.Save and then returns 200 with the city. The repository effect is not proven by the controller wrapper.
Dashboard forwards the upstream status and JSON body after parsing the response.
